response.text:
I can do that, but canceling a recurring meeting is a destructive, visible action (it will remove the event from calendars and typically notify attendees). Before I proceed I need you to confirm a few details:

1) Exact event to cancel (name and calendar if you have multiple). Example: "Weekly Design Review" on Thursdays.  
2) Scope — cancel the entire series (all future Thursdays) or just the next occurrence?  
3) Notify attendees? (Yes will send cancellation notices; No may still remove it from your calendar depending on system.)  
4) Optional: do you want a cancellation message included for attendees? If so, paste the text or say “no message.”

If you’d prefer alternatives instead of deleting, I can: pause the series for a month, change it to biweekly/monthly, shorten the meeting, or draft a message to propose those changes to attendees.

Tell me your choices and I’ll carry it out.
